llm.summary: GTY outperformed SPY and achieved CLEAN_LIFTOFF. Beta tailwind is the stated cause, although Real Estate rotation and company-specific strength cannot be separated from the supplied record.
llm.root_cause: GTY outperformed SPY and achieved CLEAN_LIFTOFF. Beta tailwind is the stated cause, although Real Estate rotation and company-specific strength cannot be separated from the supplied record.
llm.lesson: The outcome and path books captured a favorable liftoff, while regime and sector attribution require cohort evidence.
llm.engines_credit: The path-state and outcome ledgers are role models; the macro, Real Estate rotation, catalyst, and alpha organs remain unproven.

causal_chain.mechanism: A supportive beta environment was the recorded primary driver.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Absent broad participation among comparable Real Estate securities, beta would be an incomplete cause.

causal_chain.mechanism: Real Estate sensitivity may have amplified the broad tailwind.
causal_chain.counterfactual: GTY-specific residual strength would favor company alpha over sector transmission.

causal_chain.mechanism: The move developed into a CLEAN_LIFTOFF terminal path.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Failure to hold the breakout path would contradict the liftoff classification.

alternate_explanations: A Real Estate rotation may have been the direct driver.
GTY-specific accumulation or re-rating may have preceded the move.

signal_hypotheses.measurement: Measure entry-date participation, relative strength, and breakout persistence across the Real Estate cohort.
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Broader participation should accompany more durable liftoff paths.
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: Clean liftoffs are no more common when sector breadth is strong.
